answer: The cheapest real defence: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because voyage only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, mirror is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any terrace approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
